article.title: Penalty for non-compliance of direction of Central Authority.
article.content: Whoever, fails to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to twenty lakh rupees, or with both.
article.html:
88Penalty for non-compliance of direction of Central Authority.

Section 88 · Chapter VII · page 33 of the Act

Whoever, fails to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to twenty lakh rupees, or with both.
